title: Rokid launches two AI glasses and a ring to cut screen time
title_zh: Rokid一口气发两款AI眼镜和一枚戒指，想让你少看手机
lead: Chinese AR firm Rokid unveiled two AI glasses and a gesture ring on 27 October 2026, pitching them as a way to handle calls, meetings and navigation without reaching for a phone. Prices start at 3,699 yuan.
lead_zh: 2026年10月27日，中国AR公司Rokid发布了两款AI眼镜和一枚手势戒指，主打不用掏手机就能处理通话、会议和导航。起售价3699元。

paragraphs: At its Rokid Jungle 2026 event, the company introduced Rokid Glasses 2, the full-colour Rokid Color and the Rokid Ring. Glasses 2 costs 3,699 yuan in black and 3,849 yuan in tortoiseshell, or 3,199 and 3,349 yuan after state subsidies. Rokid Color starts at 4,999 yuan for 2GB+64GB and 5,499 yuan for the 4GB+64GB tortoiseshell model, while the ring sells for 1,699 yuan.

Rokid says the optical engine in Glasses 2 is 30% smaller than its predecessor's and the frame 1mm shorter, with flexible temples and redesigned nose pads. New coatings and nanoscale grooves cut rainbow artefacts by 60% and reflection by 70% while lifting grating efficiency 30%, the company claims. A Snapdragon AR1+ paired with a BES2800BP chip runs Android and RTOS side by side, allocating tasks by load.

The 263mAh battery is 25% larger, and the second-generation charging capsule refills to 90% in 30 minutes. Software features include AI meeting minutes that combine audio with first-person footage, live translation across 89 languages on WeChat, Feishu and Teams calls, two-way voice cloning, and a recall function that searches past conversations, events and photos. Custom wake words and a head-tilt shortcut are also supported.

Accessibility work leans on JD.com: Rokid is collaborating with the retailer's Explore Research Institute on the JoyAI-VL-Interaction model, delivered through JoyInside, to test obstacle warnings, object finding and spoken feedback for visually impaired users. The camera adds a pre-shot preview, a 12-megapixel sensor, 4K 30fps video and improved low-light processing.

Rokid Color uses a custom 0.16cc Micro-LED engine and weighs 55g; paired with the ring's swipe and tap gestures plus heart-rate, temperature and sleep tracking, it is meant to reduce reliance on phone screens. Rokid also cited more than 45,000 registered developers, over 12,000 built agents and 700 listed ones, alongside partnerships with Qoder, Meituan, Xiaohongshu and Tencent Mobility Services.
paragraphs_zh: 在Rokid Jungle 2026发布会上，Rokid推出了Rokid Glasses 2、全彩眼镜Rokid Color和交互戒指Rokid Ring。Glasses 2黑色款售价3699元，玳瑁色3849元，国补后分别为3199元和3349元。Rokid Color的2GB+64GB版本4999元起，4GB+64GB玳瑁色版本5499元，戒指售价1699元。
Rokid称Glasses 2的光机比上一代缩小30%，整机长度缩短1毫米，并采用柔性镜腿和重新设计的鼻托。公司表示，新镀膜和纳米级沟槽设计让彩虹纹降低60%、反射率降低70%，耦入光栅效率提升30%。芯片方面采用骁龙AR1+搭配恒玄BES2800BP，Android与RTOS双系统按任务分配资源。
电池容量263mAh，增加25%；第二代充电胶囊30分钟可充至90%。软件功能包括结合声音与第一视角画面的AI会议纪要、覆盖微信、飞书和Teams通话的89种语言实时翻译、双向音色克隆，以及可检索过往对话、事件和照片的即时回溯。还支持自定义唤醒词和抬头快捷指令。
无障碍功能方面，Rokid与京东探索研究院合作，基于京东JoyAI-VL-Interaction模型，由JoyInside提供端到端接入，为视障用户测试障碍提醒、寻物和语音反馈。影像上新增拍前预览，配备1200万像素摄像头，支持4K 30fps视频和暗光优化。
Rokid Color采用定制0.16cc Micro-LED光机，重55克；配合戒指的滑动、点击手势以及心率、体温和睡眠监测，目标是减少用户对手机屏幕的依赖。Rokid还公布注册开发者超4.5万名、已开发智能体超1.2万个、上架超700个，并与Qoder、美团、小红书、腾讯出行服务等合作。
